draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and straightforward, describing things simply as they are
notes: Do not confuse the adjective 'kuru' (dry) with the verb stem 'kuru-' from 'kurumak' (to dry, become dry).
Often used with food terms for dried ingredients (e.g. kuru fasulye 'dried beans', kuru üzüm 'raisins').
